notes.title: New Feature: Dungeon Mini Map
notes.content:
[b]How does it work?[/b]
The map unveils itself while flying through a dungeon, it will mark your position, the entrance and exit point as soon as you found it.

[b]What does it add?[/b]
It feels like a completely different and way more convenient experience solving those tricky dungeons by using the new mini map. I hope you will give this new feature a try!

[b]Note from the developer[/b]
I was asked many times to include a [b]dungeon mini map[/b] feature... well here it is. There is more to come.... stay tuned.

notes.title: Steam Leaderboard Support
notes.content:
I added Steam Leaderboards so you'll be able to compete with other players :)

[h1]How does it work?[/h1]
Every dungeon in the main game has its own leaderboard. The quicker you get through the more points you will get. But be aware that the number of rescued guys counts as a multiplier. So make sure to catch them all when you go for that high score. 

There is also a global Game Score Board.

Leaderboards can be accessed from the overworld by clicking on the panel showing your points (Steam Overlay has to be enabled). 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25570572/e0db70f18989ec655e7f465331847b3fbb8a911f.png[/img]
